title: token-efficiency.md's Model call sites says what dispatch's spend cap and kbask's fixed-remedy table now do
goal: The bl_dispatch.DEFAULT_MODEL bullet names the --max-budget-usd / KB_WORKER_BUDGET_USD cap, and the kbask.MODEL bullet names FIXED_REMEDIES and the alert kinds it answers with no session

run:
import sys
t=open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md',encoding='utf-8').read();i=t.find('## Model call sites');j=t.find('\n## ',i+3);s=' '.join(t[i:j].split())
bad=[p for p in ('no `--max-budget-usd`. Decides: the item','no per-alert remedy table exists') if p in s]
ok='KB_WORKER_BUDGET_USD' in s and 'FIXED_REMEDIES' in s
print(bad,ok);sys.exit(0 if ok and not bad else 1)
